title: Dependency declared with an open lower bound
description: package.json declares a `>=` specifier with no upper bound. Every future major release satisfies the declaration, so an incompatible or compromised release is installed without a manifest change.
remediation: Add an upper bound the project tests, or pin an exact version.
limitation: It matches a `>=` specifier with no upper bound in the parsed package.json; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
